page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head "LIBER." at top centre, page number 539 at top right. Catchword "Quin" at lower right.

main_text.p: fiat, brevi dicetur, quamvis si continuè talis ignis abiret, novum quotidie alimentum, novis id genus spiritibus creandis, novam suppeditaret materiam, Sed nonabeunt[?] radii. Revertamur ad rem. Quantum ergo procedit radius ex oculo, tantùm series illa vel ignis vel aëris, vel quorumvis corpusculorum quæ hunc radium continuant, poteft in aquam descendere. Porrò aquam laxis partibus raram, porosamque admodum quomodo talis radius penetret, qui petierit, parùm philosophicè visus fuerit dubitare de re in qua nulla subeft difficultas: ni philoso-phicum fit, iis quæ sensus captum fugiunt, assensum denegare, quid dico sensum fugiunt? Imò sensus maximè hoc capit, qui horum igniculorum, vel par-tium aëris seriem ad aquæ motum, ultro citroque commotam videt.
main_text.head: ARTICVLVS IV. Cur radius oculi moveatur in aqua non in aëre?
main_text.p: QUid sensui accommodatius? Aqua densius elementum mota hoc igneum vel aërium veluti filum tenuissimum secum trahit, aër longè rarior, ob partium laxitatem, distantiamque ab invicem his ignibus intactis transit. Quid sensui conformius? Non se contingunt partes aëris, imo longè distant ab invicem; multo longiùs hi igniculi. Quidni alia aliis relictis possint transfire?

Secus est in aqua in qua veluti in speculo cogunt se radii, ut plures simul sint; unde & majorem reddunt rei effigiem. Quippe res quæ fuerit in fundo vasis, major apparet vase aqua pleno quàm vacuo. Ergo hinc quoque causa ducitur perspicua, cur huic radio jam densiori, nimirum, ex pluribus radiis composito non cedat aqua longè densior aëre, sed eum secum trahat quoquoversum.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "nonabeunt" (line 6 of page) may be two words, "non abeunt"; marked [?]. The large initial Q of "Quid" was read as a capital Q followed by lower-case "uid". The title of the article is set in italic inside the heading. The page has no signature and no visible stains or show-through that were transcribed.
